newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Neways sees lower first-half profits.
newsitem.headline: Neways sees lower first-half profits.

text.p: Neways Electronics NV said on Wednesday it expected lower 1997 first-half profits, partly due to one-off provisions.
"Partly due to provisions that have been taken, Neways is taking into account a decline in profits in the first half of this year," the company said in a statement after its annual general meeting.
But it said the additional costs were a one-off and that a clear improvement in results relative to the 1997 first halfwas expected after a package of planned measures had been implemented.
The electronics manufacturer said that it was planning to restructure its organisation in order to better respond to the changing trends in its markets.
The restructuring would involve bundling all the sales activities of the firm's manufacturing units in a single organisation, it said.

In addition it would strengthen and expand the German-based sales organisation for its process and machine automation activities and divest its 50 percent stake in Belgian-based telecoms equipment seller Essec Europe, it said.
Neways had also signed a letter of intent to acquire a 50 percent stake in A-Nova of Slovakia, as part of its strategy to safeguard cost-effective electronics production, it added.
